scope: Only external QuickJS failure persistence and its legacy error/log records in extensions.rs. The trusted-main host failure channel, settings, source files, package content and normal code rendering are unchanged.

newFailureBehavior.rawMessage: Ignored for QuickJS persistent errors and logs; no substring replacement or truncated exception text is retained
newFailureBehavior.message: 扩展执行失败。原始异常内容未写入日志；请重试或停用该扩展。
newFailureBehavior.ownershipSource: Host record and matching activation lease are validated before persistence
newFailureBehavior.leaseCleanup: The failed activation is revoked; the other project activation and its in-flight ownership remain separate

legacyMigration.trigger: initialize, or the first QuickJS failure write when the record predates the privacy marker
legacyMigration.errors: Old EXTENSION_FAILED text becomes the fixed safe summary; missing historical activation identity stays null
legacyMigration.logs: Only exact complete fixed host lifecycle messages survive; all other legacy messages become a fixed redacted diagnostic entry. Entries are reconstructed from allowed fields; arbitrary extra fields are discarded. Valid timestamps are retained.

cases: Fake token, absolute path and source-body marker are absent from persisted registry bytes and the production log snapshot
Structured safe reason and verified instance/project attribution survive; another project activation remains
Stale activation rejection leaves registry byte-identical
Legacy exact-message allowlist rejects message prefixes containing private content; policy and settings stay unchanged; migration is idempotent
Trusted-main error text and logs retain their prior behavior
test.boundary: Tests call the production persistence helper and log-snapshot helper used by runtime_failed/extension_logs. They do not claim a real QuickJS throw or GUI interaction.

initialBuildAttempt.result: Failed before tests because an old settings.rs test still referenced removed sanitize during the parallel settings repair. The settings owner removed that stale test; this command then passed.
